# Accessibility

BookWorm's client applications target the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.

👉 **[Frontend Accessibility Architecture & Practices](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/frontend/005-accessibility)** — Accessibility priorities, automated checks, keyboard/screen-reader practices, supported environments, and barrier reporting.

To report an accessibility barrier, open an [Accessibility Issue](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml).
